input.question: Do you know what caused the basement flooding — for example, was it a burst pipe or leak from your plumbing, or did water enter from outside (heavy rain, groundwater seepage, neighbor's property)?

input.value: burst or failed plumbing in policyholder's home

input.rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement structure (hardwood floor, drywall) and contents (boxes) caused by failure of the policyholder's internal plumbing is classic property_damage coverage.

Extensive water damage affecting hardwood floors and drywall across a full basement plus loss of contents (multiple boxes) indicates damage in the $5,000–$25,000 range; no injuries reported, and this is below the high-severity threshold of $25,000+ or immediate on-site adjuster need.

input.claim_summary: Basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of standing water following a failure of the policyholder's internal plumbing while claimant was on a work trip. Damage includes buckled hardwood floors, water-soaked drywall (up to 1 foot high), and ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage in the $5,000–$25,000 range; medium severity.
